understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to win each level by moving the available selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; once a level reports WIN, progress continues until all levels are completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn consisted of a CLICK action on a target grid coordinate. A click either selected a piece (if the click was on/associated with a movable piece) or issued a move command for the currently selected piece toward the clicked tile. The selected piece would move to the target position if a valid path/slide was available, otherwise it would not move (blocked by walls/obstacles, invalid move, or no movement effect). Pieces could not pass through walls/obstacles and would stop when blocked. Completion required positioning pieces onto goal tiles within the finite step budget.
